claims: Millennials are generally defined as those born between 1981 and 1996.
Some definitions of Millennials extend to 2000.
Pew Research defines Millennials' birth years as 1981–1996.
Some sources suggest Millennials' birth years as 1980–2000.
Millennials comprise the largest portion of the U.S. labor force.
Millennials comprise 36% of the U.S. labor force.
Millennials entered the workforce during the Great Recession.
Millennials are often dubbed the "burnout generation".
Millennials have driven the shared economy.
Millennials are delaying homeownership due to economic constraints.
Millennials are delaying marriage due to economic constraints
